health.label: Health
health.note: A shape and a word for warn, unknown, stale and error; empty for OK and for nothing reported.

level.label: Level
level.note: What to act on now (stale once overdue).

rank.label: Rank
rank.note: ok 0 < warn 1 < unknown 2 < stale 3 < error 4; -1 when nothing reports (sorting worst first).

measured.label: Measured
measured.note: Every measurement as the host writes it, the headline first.

value.label: Value
value.note: The headline number (the first measurement), in its unit.

unit.label: Unit
unit.note: As the record writes it (UCUM: Cel, mrad, 1).

better.label: Better
better.note: lower or higher: which way the number improves.

metric.label: Headline
metric.note: The headline measurement's key (p90, max, share).

t0.label: Window from
t0.note: The evidence window in its run, s from the run's start.

diagnostic.label: Diagnostic
diagnostic.note: The stock diagnostic's id (robotdx.diagnostics' catalog entry), empty for a check no stock diagnostic made.

binding.label: Binding
binding.note: The host's binding that ran it (diagnostics.toml).

hint.label: View
hint.note: The data-ui view that shows it (CONTRACT §35: gate_matrix, threshold_band, kpi_trend, rollup_tree, evidence, distribution, level_history, path_overlay).
